fields.acceptance_criteria: a standalone interruption-recovery instruction file exists under .agents/instructions/orchestration/; it directs the next agent to locate loose ends and resume at the interruption point rather than assuming completion or restarting from a rough boundary; stale board entries are the sole prescribed detection signal; recovery auto-reconstructs a draft handoff-equivalent that a human confirms before execution proceeds; a dedicated resume-interrupted prompt template exists under .agents/prompts/; no staleness threshold is added to durable session runtimes
fields.title: [agent-workflow] Interruption-recovery instructions and a resume-interrupted prompt template
